plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Political Science AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7987/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 60-61; lower bound 60 encoded = 15+16+15+14 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 4 first elective 2-3 -> 2). The map's description text calls it an 'AS-T Program' (apparent typo; the degree title is AA-T). IMPORTANT: the map states 'The program faculty requires you connect with them instead of following this program map' and 'YOU ARE REQUIRED TO meet with PROGRAM FACULTY for specific transfer course evaluation or transferring to a specific 4-year institution.' It is also highly recommended that students consider an internship with a participating agency or department. POLS C1000 or POLS C1000H (Honors; enrollment limited to Honors Program students; also listed as HONOR 367). POLS 382 prerequisite per map: Intermediate Algebra or the equivalent (documented here; not a course code). The map sequences two Cal-GETC Area 2 courses (POLS 382 for the major plus a general Area 2) and two Area 4 courses (POLS C1000/C1000H plus a non-POLS Area 4 per map footnote). List A (minimum 3 units; one 3-unit slot sequenced in Semester 3): POLS 312, POLS 313, POLS 314, POLS 315, POLS 317, POLS 318, POLS 319, POLS 324 (all advisory ENGL C1000). The Semester 2 and Semester 4 elective footnotes suggest a course from List A. Advisories: POLS 302 advisory ENGL C1000; POLS 310 advisory ENGL C1000. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
